doc.title: Karolina Strassmayer interviewed by Monk Rowe, May 25, 2023

title: Cannonball Adderley as a hero and the Gil Evans project
summary: Shared admiration for Cannonball Adderley; she has been invited to perform the Gil Evans album New Bottle, Old Wine in Zurich.

story.theme_name: Playing with and around Miles Davis
story.community_name: Cannonball Adderley: the sound, the man, the band

blocks.x: Yeah you and I actually have something in common.

Oh yes. Cannonball Adderley — my still to this day is such a hero. Actually I just recently got an invitation to perform with the Zurich Jazz Orchestra, “New Bottle, Old Wine” the Gil Evans album featuring Cannonball Adderley. And I am absolutely thrilled and so honored and mortified at the same time because this is such a seminal recording and such an influential recording and to be asked to not re-create but perform it is quite an honor but also it’s scary.
Well I want to give you a little encouragement because I was just listening to one of your videos on your website, “Calling For You” and I could hear him in your sound.

He’s still in there, he’s in my heart and just, when I first heard him I had no idea what jazz was. I had no idea which instruments were playing. It was really — I grew up in a very small village in the Austrian Alps and I had to commute to go to high school. And a small group of us kids we had to be at the train station at 5:30 every morning to make it
